_comment: The Foundry models to register in settings/aiModels with deploy/seed-ai-models.sh (#120), until the test suite (#121) sets temperatureMode and jobs itself. 'deployment' is the deployment name as shown in Foundry. 'jobs' is what each model is allowed to be made active for (recipes, photos, genericNames); 'temperatureMode' is 'default' for a model that only accepts its default temperature (gpt-6-luna), else 'usual'. Nothing here chooses which model is in use.
